import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import ChooseConfirmApp from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/chooseConfirm/app';
import ActionConfirmApp from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/actionConfirm/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addSoulQuote, getCommandArgument, sendSoulGui } from '@src/response/soulPath/shared';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const token = getCommandArgument(e.MessageText, '确认神魂');

  if (token.startsWith('choose:')) {
    const result = await ChooseConfirmApp({
      bid: e.UserId,
      uid: e.uid as number,
      token: token.slice('choose:'.length),
      request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
    });

    if (!result.success) {
      md.addText(result.message);
    } else {
      const [headline, ...details] = result.data.message.split('。').filter(Boolean);

      md.addBold(headline);
      if (details.length) {
        md.addNewline();
        addSoulQuote(md, details.join('。'));
      }
      md.addNewline();
      addSoulQuote(md, `已领悟【${result.data.nodeName}】。`);
    }
  } else {
    const result = await ActionConfirmApp({ bid: e.UserId, uid: e.uid as number, token, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (!result.success) {
      md.addText(result.message);
    } else if (result.data.path) {
      const [headline, ...details] = result.data.path.message.split('。').filter(Boolean);

      md.addBold(headline);
      if (details.length) {
        md.addNewline();
        addSoulQuote(md, details.join('。'));
      }
      md.addNewline();
      addSoulQuote(md, `已领悟【${result.data.path.nodeName}】。`);
    } else if (result.data.nurture) {
      const data = result.data.nurture;

      md.addBold(`重选 · ${data.directionName} · ${data.tierName}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(
        `稳定 ${data.stabilityBefore} → ${data.stabilityAfter} · 感悟 ${data.insightGained >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${data.insightGained} · 熟练 ${data.proficiencyGained >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${data.proficiencyGained}`
      );
      md.addNewline();
      addSoulQuote(md, '以上为重选前后差额。');
      md.addText(`新额外材料：${data.extraItems.length ? data.extraItems.map(item => `${item.name}×${item.quantity}`).join('、') : '无'}`);
    }
  }
  await message.send(
    sendSoulGui(e, '神魂操作结果', md, [
      { label: '道途印证', command: '/道途印证' },
      { label: '道途', command: '/元婴道途' },
      { label: '温养', command: '/元婴神魂' }
    ])
  );
});
